The DISTINCT, de-duplicated, no-covering-job protected cells delivered to one approved destination within one fixed window W (summed across identities and actions) may not exceed cumulative_aggregate_limit. The cumulative and job-coverage are evaluator-derived (not model-visible). declared_purpose is NOT an authorization basis.
